routing_rules.primary_regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Foods for Infant Nutrition) Regulations, 2020
routing_rules.engine_rule: Resolve the exact infant-food identity and its infant-nutrition composition/additive rules before any Appendix A conclusion. Do not apply ordinary-food additive permissions or a Proprietary Food fallback.

routing_rules.primary_regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals, Food for Special Dietary Use, Food for Special Medical Purpose, Functional Food and Novel Food) Regulations, 2016, as currently applicable
routing_rules.engine_rule: Use the FSMP route and its category-specific additive provisions. Chapter 2.12 Proprietary Food is excluded.

routing_rules.primary_regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals, Food for Special Dietary Use, Food for Special Medical Purpose, Functional Food and Novel Food) Regulations, 2016, as currently applicable
routing_rules.engine_rule: Use the FSDU/special-diet route and its category-specific provisions. Do not infer compliance from ordinary-food Appendix A permissions.

routing_rules.primary_regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals, Food for Special Dietary Use, Food for Special Medical Purpose, Functional Food and Novel Food) Regulations, 2016, as currently applicable
routing_rules.engine_rule: Use the applicable health-supplement/nutraceutical/special-category regulation and its additive permissions. Chapter 2.12 Proprietary Food is excluded where the product falls in an excluded class.
